answer_1.quote: Opinion summarization aims at producing a summary for a set of subjective user reviews about an entity (i.e., a product, a service or a movie), which can help users quickly understand the entity.

answer_2.quote: We show the automatic metrics and human evaluation below. ROUGE Diversity (Div↓) uses self-BLEU which measures BLEU scores of each generated sentence by considering others as reference.

answer_4.quote: We ask three human annotators, who are native or proficient English speakers to rank gold summary and summaries generated by OURS and TranSum under 5 aspects: Fluency (Flu.), Non-redundancy (NR.), Opinion Consistency (Cons.) and Overall.
answer_4.guideline: rank gold summary and summaries generated by OURS and TranSum under 5 aspects: Fluency (Flu.), Non-redundancy (NR.), Opinion Consistency (Cons.) and Overall.
